_comment: The portfolio list shown on the landing page. Order here is the order shown. A project may live in this repo or in another one; url is relative when the path is served from iprash.github.io, so an entry does not change when a project is consolidated into this repo. Drop a screenshot at assets/shots/<slug>.png and the card picks it up on the next build; without one the card renders a generated tile instead. Set listed:false to park an entry without deleting it.

projects.title: MyFIFA26
projects.blurb: A what-if analyser for the 2026 World Cup. Group standings, a clinch checker, third-place qualification worked out from FIFA's own Annex C table, and a knockout bracket you can pick your way through.
